name: joplin_check_note_todo
intent: Check whether a Joplin note is marked as a todo item
description: Opens the named note in Joplin, opens its Actions menu, and reports whether it is marked as a todo item. The presence of a 'Convert to note' option indicates it is currently a todo.
patterns: Is a Joplin note marked as a todo item?
Check if a note is a todo in Joplin
Is the note a todo or a regular note?

inputs.name: note_title
inputs.description: Title of the Joplin note to check

steps.intent: Tap the note titled {{note_title}} in the list
Tap the Actions button to inspect the note type

data_values: Call mom to wish her a happy birthday.
